question: What yogic technique involving breath at the root of tongue and palate should be practiced slowly?
premises: A placement is made at the root of tongue and palate.
The vital air is the object of practice.
The action should be done slowly.
inference: Therefore one should slowly draw in the vital air at the root of the tongue and palate.
plain_english: Placing it at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the breath.
